literature_notes: All five ledger lines were examined carefully. L1 and L2 describe antibody epitope-mapping experiments using LILRB3 domain-deletion constructs transfected into HEK293F cells; these are explicitly excluded because 'where an antibody binds is not where a tag was inserted.' L3, L4, and L5 all describe chimeric receptor constructs in which the LILRB3 ectodomain is fused to an intracellular signaling domain (CD3ζ or PILRβ-TM-ICD) for functional ligand-screening assays. None of these lines reports an epitope-tag knock-in, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon/domain-insertion screen, or antibody-epitope insertion at any specific residue or loop of the LILRB3 extracellular domain. No ledger line qualifies under the evidence rules, so zero sites are proposed.
